capabilities.name: Composition canvas
capabilities.purpose: Provides a full-frame surface with project-wide background, color and spacing defaults.
creatorActions: Place and style content within a video frame
suggestedPrompts: Create a clean title card using Canvas with a dark blue background.

integration.timeline: Composition-level; it is not an editable timeline clip.
integration.editor: Rendered by a project composition using the Remotion player.

limitations: Canvas applies 80px default padding; provide a style override for edge-to-edge layouts.

capabilities.name: Frame-based scene sequence
capabilities.purpose: Places content over an explicit frame range and gives it a local frame clock.
creatorActions: Arrange a video from timed scenes
Animate content relative to a scene start
suggestedPrompts: Split the composition into three scenes with explicit frame ranges and use Scene for each one.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start frame in the parent composition.

integration.timeline: Composition-level sequence; not a project editTimeline clip.
integration.editor: Seek and frame state follow the Remotion composition.

limitations: Scene ranges are authored in composition code.

capabilities.name: Frame-based fade
capabilities.purpose: Fades children in and out using the active Remotion frame and sequence duration.
creatorActions: Add deterministic entrance and exit fades
Combine a fade with any React composition content
suggestedPrompts: Fade this title in and out over 12 frames without using CSS clocks.

integration.timeline: Composition-level; not independently editable on the timeline.
integration.editor: Controlled by code within the containing composition.

limitations: Keep the containing sequence longer than twice the fade duration.

capabilities.name: Kinetic text
capabilities.purpose: Reveals words with frame-driven staggered opacity and vertical motion.
creatorActions: Control stagger timing, scale and color
suggestedPrompts: Use KineticText for a two-line headline with a 4-frame word stagger.

integration.timeline: Composition-level component; no declared editable clip fields.
integration.editor: Edit its React props in the owning project composition.

limitations: Animation is deterministic from the current frame; it does not inspect or edit project timeline data.

capabilities.name: Animated chat bubble
capabilities.purpose: Shows a message bubble with a spring entrance and left or right alignment.
suggestedPrompts: Create two ChatBubble messages on opposite sides, with the second delayed by 20 frames.

integration.timeline: Composition-level component; no declared editable clip fields.
integration.editor: Edit its React props in the owning project composition.

limitations: Requires a Remotion composition frame context.

capabilities.name: Comic pop
capabilities.purpose: Scales and rotates a short text treatment with a spring and offset shadow.
creatorActions: Emphasize a short word or label
suggestedPrompts: Use ComicPop for one short emphasis word in the title scene.

integration.timeline: Composition-level component; no declared editable clip fields.
integration.editor: Edit its React props in the owning project composition.

limitations: The component uses a large fixed text size; scale it through a containing layout if needed.

capabilities.name: Animated number counter
capabilities.purpose: Interpolates a numeric value over a fixed frame interval.
creatorActions: Choose start, end, duration and suffix
suggestedPrompts: Animate a count from 0 to 100 over 90 frames and append a percent sign.

integration.timeline: Composition-level component; no declared editable clip fields.
integration.editor: Edit its React props in the owning project composition.

capabilities.name: Timed word highlighting
capabilities.purpose: Highlights supplied word intervals against the current composition time.
creatorActions: Build karaoke text from word timings
Choose highlight color and optional time source
suggestedPrompts: Render these verified word timings with KaraokeWords; keep unknown timestamps untimed.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Optional explicit time; defaults to frame / fps.

integration.timeline: Composition-level renderer. The separate subtitle module offers editable timeline clips.
integration.editor: Timing data is supplied by the project; this component does not estimate it.

limitations: The component highlights supplied timings only and never aligns audio automatically.

capabilities.name: Subtitles and lyrics clips
capabilities.purpose: Renders independent timed text segments with optional word-level karaoke highlighting.
creatorActions: Reuse timing with another visual style
suggestedPrompts: Use subtitleModule for editable lyric clips and keep words in segment-relative seconds.

parameters.name: words
parameters.description: Optional word intervals in seconds relative to the clip.

integration.timeline: Editable clip component with schema-declared inspector fields, segment timing and optional word timing.
integration.editor: Registered by the project; generic field UI and subtitle-specific import/export are available in the current desktop editor.

limitations: Text corrections preserve segment timing and word intervals. If the word labels no longer match their intervals, karaoke highlighting pauses until matching intervals are supplied; automatic alignment is not launched from the editor.

capabilities.name: Lyric timing and reconciliation
capabilities.purpose: Validates word timings, reconciles transcript words with original lyrics and converts common subtitle formats.
suggestedPrompts: Reconcile this transcript with the supplied lyrics, preserve unmatched words as unknown, and export canonical JSON.

parameters.name: original
parameters.description: Correct text to align against transcript words.

parameters.name: transcript
parameters.description: Word text and optional second-based start/end values.

integration.timeline: Pure timing data can be converted to subtitle clips with @motion/lyrics-sync/subtitles.
integration.editor: The Lyrics Sync workbench edits seconds-based boundaries and exports; it is not a live alignment service.

dependencies: Optional local Python Whisper worker for transcription estimates
limitations: Reconciliation is lexical and order-preserving, not semantic forced alignment. Song accuracy is unverified.

capabilities.name: Editable timeline data
capabilities.purpose: Validates frame-based tracks and clips and provides reusable range and field operations.
suggestedPrompts: Create a version-1 edit timeline with explicit integer frame ranges and validate it with parseEditTimeline.

parameters.name: tracks / clips
parameters.description: Clips use track IDs and integer frame ranges.

integration.timeline: This is the editor's reusable data contract; helpers are independent of the timeline DOM.
integration.editor: TimelineEditor currently provides the desktop UI for selection, movement, trimming and declared field editing.

limitations: No keyframes, ripple editing, multi-select, snapping or time stretching.

capabilities.name: Remotion preview player
capabilities.purpose: Plays and seeks a React composition using manifest dimensions, FPS and duration.
suggestedPrompts: Mount StudioPlayer with this composition and project manifest, and keep the composition's input props explicit.

parameters.name: inputProps
parameters.description: Optional props passed to the composition.

integration.timeline: Accepts compositions that consume the editable timeline prop.
integration.editor: The desktop shell controls playback through @motion/player/host and a local message contract.

limitations: Preview playback is separate from the Node rendering pipeline; frame reload resets playback.

capabilities.name: Video and still rendering
capabilities.purpose: Bundles one project composition and renders an MP4 or still image with Remotion.
creatorActions: Produce a still for visual review
suggestedPrompts: Render the saved project as an MP4 and verify the output dimensions and frame rate.

parameters.name: still
parameters.description: Render a PNG still instead of an MP4.

integration.timeline: Rendering reads the saved project composition and its timeline data.
integration.editor: Invoked by CLI; no render job panel exists in the editor yet.

limitations: Rendering is a CLI operation and may need the managed Chrome runtime.

capabilities.name: Project discovery and validation
capabilities.purpose: Discovers project folders and validates manifests and contained file paths.
creatorActions: Validate manifests before preview or render
suggestedPrompts: Use discover to list valid project manifests and report per-project errors without stopping discovery.

parameters.name: relative
parameters.description: Path validated within one project folder.

integration.timeline: Loads the manifest and optional timeline file references.
integration.editor: Used by the shell, development server and renderer.

limitations: Path validation is not an operating-system sandbox for project code.

capabilities.name: Narration audio component
capabilities.purpose: Renders a local audio source inside a Remotion composition with source offset and volume controls.
creatorActions: Add narration or music from project-local media
suggestedPrompts: Import a licensed local audio file and use Narration with an explicit volume; keep the asset inside the project.

integration.timeline: Composition-level audio; no audio track editing or waveform UI exists.
integration.editor: Imported by project code and rendered by Remotion.

limitations: No bundled audio, waveform display, beat detection, or audio trimming UI.

capabilities.name: Mascot 2.5D
capabilities.purpose: Animated procedural SVG mascot with subtitle-linked comic mouth and bubble
creatorActions: Make a mascot dance, walk, jump or idle
Link comic speech to a subtitle clip ID
suggestedPrompts: Add mascotModule to the timeline, make it dance and link speechClipId to an existing subtitle clip; do not invent audio timings.

parameters.name: speechClipId
parameters.description: Use a real subtitles clip as speaking-time authority

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Fill color of the SVG mascot body.

integration.timeline: Editable mascot-2p5d clip using timeline v1
integration.editor: Generic inspector fields, existing save and undo/redo

limitations: No audio sync or phoneme alignment
